findings.title: VerifyCurrentProjectionSet derives superseded / released-epoch sets as current
findings.evidence: current-probe-results.json: with Current built from each set's own fields, cohort-01..cohort-33 (operation fixture-operation-migration, fenceEpoch 1, lease-migration HELD) and cohort-35 (superseded by cohort-36) all ACCEPT, although the same authenticated packet contains fence-released (mode RELEASED, same operation, epoch 1) and lease-restore (epoch 2 HELD). cohort-34 rejects only incidentally ('current original Node projection binding mismatch'). The owner negative in TestRegeneratedEphemeralCryptoPacketAndCurrentDerivedSet ('released epoch1 substituted for current restore-held epoch2') passes only because SetID != Current.SetID ('no trusted current set context'); it never tests a released-epoch Current.
findings.code: services/node-agent/migrationverify/verify.go VerifyCurrentProjectionSet: lease found by hash with operationId/migrationId/fenceEpoch/expiresAt only; no mode==HELD, no Current.LeaseEnvelopeSHA256==Operations[op].LeaseEnvelopeSHA256, no check that no authenticated RELEASED lease for the same operation/epoch or higher-epoch HELD lease exists, no latest-sequence check.
findings.fix: Require lease body mode HELD and equality with the trusted operation's lease hash; reject when the authenticated packet contains a RELEASED lease for that operation/epoch or any authenticated lease with a higher fence epoch; require the set to be the maximal authenticated sequence for its operation; add negatives that build Current from cohort-33, cohort-34 and cohort-35 with all hashes consistent.

findings.title: History temporal model forces a released operation to be presented as a current trusted operation
findings.evidence: Verify evaluates every embedded fresh proof against trusted Now (age<=min(plan,120s), now<validUntil) and requires its operation in TrustedContext.Operations with Now inside the lease (proofs.go freshness/proofOperation). The fixture signs every proof of both operations at one instant (Now=2030-01-01T00:00:00Z) and gives both operations the identical window 00:00:00..00:01:00 (time-probe-results.json), so Verify passes only while the RELEASED epoch-1 operation is simultaneously supplied as a current unexpired operation. A real history whose epoch-1 fresh proofs are older than 120s, or whose epoch-1 operation is correctly no longer current, cannot verify; the correct outcome is neither specified nor tested.
findings.fix: Specify and implement a history mode: authenticate an embedded fresh proof against its own operation's authenticated lease window and the record's signed time (historical, non-transferable), and apply current Now/120s/current-operation only in the current derivation; or explicitly restrict Verify to single-instant packets and say so in the contract. Replace the single-instant fixture with a multi-time timeline (epoch-1 acquired/released before epoch-2) and test both outcomes.

findings.title: Native leaf EKU is weaker than the producer's check
findings.evidence: current-probe-results.json: x509 Verify with KeyUsages=[ServerAuth] ACCEPTS a leaf with no EKU (clientAuth-only rejects). native.go relies on that Verify only, while transport/peer_floor.go requires hasUsage(cert, ServerAuth). Mitigated because the leaf DER is the exact registered member DER.
findings.fix: Require explicit ExtKeyUsageServerAuth (and KeyUsageDigitalSignature) on the leaf, matching the producer.

findings.title: Native signed observedAt is not bound to the trusted challenge window
findings.evidence: semantic-probe-results.json native-observed-before-challenge-issued: ACCEPT with challenge IssuedAt 5s after the Node-signed observedAt (control at Now+10s also ACCEPT).
findings.fix: Require IssuedAt-30s <= observed < ExpiresAt for the matched challenge.

findings.title: Packet bytes are not defensively copied
findings.evidence: verify.go/proofs.go hash, parse, re-canonicalize and (native) re-hash the caller-owned Records/Referents slices in separate reads; a caller that mutates them concurrently gets an authenticated value that need not equal the hashed bytes. Static finding; inputs are documented immutable.
findings.fix: Copy each []byte once at Verify entry and use only the copies.
